Meanwhile, a wounded Zimbabwe may have nothing much to offer, and they may surrender yet again. Therefore, expect the win probability meter to lean in Afghanistan’s favor.  Afghanistan eyeing a series clean sweep 
 Afghanistan will head into the final T20I against Zimbabwe with confidence soaring after sealing the three-match series with a game to spare. The visitors produced a spirited comeback in the second T20I at Sharjah, edging out Zimbabwe in a thrilling contest to take an unassailable 2-0 lead. Having already secured the series, Afghanistan will now set their sights on completing a memorable 3-0 clean sweep.
 The star of the previous encounter was Azmatullah Omarzai, whose maiden T20I century proved to be the difference in a high-scoring thriller. His match-winning knock overshadowed Sikandar Raza’s brilliant century for Zimbabwe, as Afghanistan held their nerve in a contest that swung repeatedly between the two sides. Omarzai’s all-round abilities have added significant balance to the Afghan lineup, making them an even more dangerous outfit.
 With momentum firmly on their side, Afghanistan will look to continue their aggressive brand of cricket and maintain their winning streak. Zimbabwe, meanwhile, will be eager to avoid a whitewash and end the series on a positive note. Another closely fought battle could be on the cards, but Afghanistan remain favorites to complete the clean sweep and finish the series unbeaten.
 Zimbabwe have a lot to do to bounce back 
 Zimbabwe will enter the final T20I with plenty of soul-searching to do after surrendering the series despite posting a formidable total in the second match. The defeat was particularly painful because skipper Sikandar Raza produced a magnificent century, only for Afghanistan to chase down the target thanks to an even better knock from Azmatullah Omarzai. It was a result that left Raza visibly frustrated, with the captain openly questioning his side’s complacency and lack of intensity in crucial moments.
 While Zimbabwe have shown flashes of brilliance throughout the series, their inability to capitalize on winning positions has proved costly. The batting unit has largely revolved around Raza’s heroics, and the team will need greater contributions from the top and middle order if they are to challenge Afghanistan consistently. The bowlers, too, will be under pressure to deliver after struggling to defend a strong total in the previous encounter.
 With the series already lost, Zimbabwe’s primary objective will be restoring pride and ending the tour on a positive note. A victory in the final game would not change the series outcome, but it would provide a much-needed confidence boost and prove that they can compete with one of the most dangerous T20 sides in world cricket.  Weather Conditions and Pitch Report 
 Here’s the pitch and weather report for the Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe 3rd T20I in the UAE at the Sharjah Cricket Stadium in Sharjah.
 Pitch Report Weather Report 
 Sharjah is known for its slow and slightly two-paced surface, making stroke-making challenging. Clear skies are expected throughout the match with no significant threat of rain. 
 Spinners are likely to play a key role, especially during the middle overs. The temperature is expected to hover around 30-32°C during the game. 
 Pacers can extract some movement with the new ball before the pitch settles down. Humidity levels will be moderate, but conditions should remain comfortable for cricket. 
 The average first-innings total at the venue is around 155-160 runs. Light winds are expected, offering little assistance to bowlers. 
 A score in the range of 165-175 could prove to be a match-winning total. Dew is unlikely to have a major impact on the contest. 
 Teams winning the toss may prefer to bat first and put runs on the board. The weather is set to remain ideal for a full 20-over clash without interruptions. 
 Toss Prediction 
 Afghanistan have won both their games so far in the series batting first, whereas Zimbabwe’s losses in both games came when they failed to chase scores. Therefore, Sikandar Raza would not mind batting first in this game, whereas Afghanistan also will look to keep up with their batting first tactics.
 Where to Watch Today’s Match 
 The online live streaming of the 3rd T20I match of the Afghanistan vs Zimbabwe Series in the UAE 2026 will take place live on the FANCODE  app. The live TV coverage for this series won’t be available in India.
 AFG vs ZIM: Today’s Match Predictions 
 Afghanistan will go for the kill. Having won the opening two games of the series, Afghanistan will now look to make it three wins in a row and complete a series cleansweep. Zimbabwe’s T20I record against Afghanistan has been terrible, and it would be tough for them to bounce back. Therefore, as per our prediction, the hosts, Afghanistan, are expected to win the AFG vs ZIM 3rd T20I match.
